frame.note: x=0 is the team's own alliance wall, +x toward the opponent wall; y follows WPILib after the symmetry transform; *_norm values are 0..1 of the full field

legend: Rank score = seconds per counted match the robot is STOPPED (smoothed speed < 0.5 m/s) with its centre on any bump, added up over the whole match (a beached robot's position wobbles on and off the bump, so it need not be one unbroken stretch); driving over at speed does not count. Checked against Manta scout notes on 2026cur: per-team rank correlation +0.42 with how often scouts wrote 'beached'. Episodes (for finding it in the video) = stretches with >= 2 s stopped on one bump, gaps < 2 s allowed. A robot can also park on a bump on purpose — check the video. Positions are median-smoothed over 1 s; speed = smoothed displacement across a centred 1 s window ÷ its duration, never across a tracking gap > 0.6 s or a tracker-slot change. Runs of bit-identical positions longer than 0.5 s are stalled tracking: if the robot is still within 0.3 m of that spot when tracking resumes it sat still (counted as stationary), otherwise those seconds are unknown and excluded. A match counts only with >= 30 s of valid tracking; fewer than 2 counted matches = low data.
